definitions.target_commit_distribution_mismatch: 0.5 * sum_i(abs(target_share_i - commit_share_i)); null when there are no commits
definitions.max_unresolved_target_streak: maximum, over members, of consecutive opportunities in which that member was targeted without that member receiving the committed write-back
definitions.tokens_per_commit: optimization-phase arm ledger total_tokens divided by Shadow-approved commits; null when commits=0

labels_in_priority_order.label: PRIMARY_RESPONSIBILITY_SCHEDULER_SUPPORTED
labels_in_priority_order.rule: B mismatch < A mismatch AND B tokens_per_commit < A tokens_per_commit AND B Validation50 VoteAcc >= A Validation50 VoteAcc

labels_in_priority_order.label: MECHANISM_SIGNAL_WITHOUT_FULL_QUALITY_SUPPORT
labels_in_priority_order.rule: B mismatch < A mismatch OR B tokens_per_commit < A tokens_per_commit, but the full supported rule is false

labels_in_priority_order.label: HOLD
labels_in_priority_order.rule: official protocol/audit gate fails or a required comparison is undefined
